# Brand Banao Digital

> Brand Banao Digital is a digital marketing, web development, and media production agency in Delhi NCR, India. We specialize in building lightning-fast websites, producing high-converting Instagram Reels, managing paid ads, and executing local SEO strategies for businesses, brand creators, and political campaigns.

## General Information

- **Company Name:** Brand Banao Digital
- **Website:** https://brandbanaodigital.in/

- **Pricing Range:** ₹5,999 – ₹42,999
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/brandbanaodigital.in

---

## Core Services & Solutions

### 1. Web Development
Custom, lightning-fast website design and development tailored for business branding, e-commerce, and governance needs. Includes responsive UI/UX, GenAI chatbot integrations, and structured data setup.

### 2. Reels & Video Production
End-to-end short-form video content creation designed for high reach on Instagram and YouTube. Services include scriptwriting, shooting, editing, and political/brand digital storytelling.

### 3. Local SEO & Digital Marketing
Comprehensive search engine optimization focusing on Google Map Pack placement, hyper-local keyword targeting, paid advertising campaigns, and digital footprint management in Delhi NCR and regional areas like Rajasthan.

### 4. Political & Election Campaign Strategy
Constituency-first campaign management, digital outreach, localized issue messaging, social media administration, and voter discovery web platforms.

- **The Indian Spice Co.** ([https://theindianspiceco.in/](https://theindianspiceco.in/)): Modernized web presence featuring a scalable user interface and Generative AI chatbot integration.
- **Swaroop Singh Khara (Political Leader)** ([https://swaroopsinghkhara.com/](https://swaroopsinghkhara.com/)): Constituency-focused portal containing localized issue tracking, event coverage, and voter discovery optimizations.
- **Manpasand Enterprises** ([https://manpasandenterprises.co.in/](https://manpasandenterprises.co.in/)): Corporate web application complete with digital product catalog, inquiry capture forms, and Google Business profile sync.
